basics.name: Shadman Sakib
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Engineer specializing in backend development (Java, Spring Boot) for enterprise-scale government systems, with research focused on automated software verification and model conformance, large language models for requirements engineering, and trustworthy AI.

work.name: Synesis IT PLC
highlights: Backend development in Java and Spring Boot for enterprise-scale government information systems, working with real-world software complexity, legacy maintenance, and long-term system evolution.
Refactored legacy modules to reduce technical debt and improve structural consistency across large, distributed codebases.
Designed JWT-based authentication and authorisation across distributed microservices; developed RESTful APIs serving high-volume production traffic.

work.name: Synesis IT PLC
highlights: Contributed to the national E-TIN tax platform backend, integrating authentication workflows and improving service modularity.
Participated in a full Agile/Scrum development lifecycle across a multi-team engineering organisation.
Thesis: LLM-Based Requirements Generation from User Reviews — an agentic, prompt-driven pipeline that extracts structured functional requirements from unstructured app-store reviews.
Evaluated machine-generated requirements against human-written baselines using semantic similarity and structural validity metrics.

publications.name: From Reviews to Requirements: Can LLMs Generate Human-Like User Stories?
publications.summary: An automated pipeline generating structured software requirements from app-store user feedback, evaluating prompting strategies and categorising failure modes in LLM-generated requirements.

publications.name: From Chat to Checkup: Can Large Language Models Assist in Diabetes Prediction?
publications.summary: Benchmarked LLM-based inference against traditional ML classifiers on the Pima Indians Diabetes Dataset, analysing reliability and failure conditions of generative models in a safety-critical context.

projects.name: Automated Requirements Conformance Evaluation
projects.summary: B.Sc. thesis extension on structural conformance of LLM-generated requirements.
highlights: Built a taxonomy of structural conformance failures in LLM-generated user stories.
Developed Python scripts to automate structural and semantic comparison between generated and reference artefacts.

projects.name: Multimodal Emotion Recognition System
projects.summary: Computer vision + NLP pipeline for real-time emotion prediction.
highlights: Fused CNN-based facial feature extraction with NLP text-sentiment embeddings for real-time emotion prediction.
Applied preprocessing optimisations and hyperparameter tuning to improve cross-modal fusion performance.
